mapper.sql: id, user_id, url, original_name, file_size, content_type, status, create_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM file WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file ( id, user_id, url, original_name, file_size, content_type, status, create_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{url}, #{originalName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{status}, #{createTime}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE file SET status = 'used' WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
